plan.title: Scholarship Applicant Overview
plan.subtitle: Key metrics and trends related to scholarship applications.

panels.title: Total Applicants
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM scholarship_applicants

panels.title: Applicants by Status
panels.sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM scholarship_applicants GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Applicants by Taluka
panels.sql: SELECT taluka, COUNT(*) AS count FROM scholarship_applicants GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Average Marks by Category
panels.sql: SELECT category, AVG(marks) AS avg_marks FROM scholarship_applicants GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Monthly Application Trend
panels.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', dob) AS month, COUNT(*) AS count FROM scholarship_applicants GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Top 10 Applicants by Marks
panels.sql: SELECT "Naam", "Marks %" FROM scholarship_applicants ORDER BY "Marks %" DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Average Family Income
panels.sql: SELECT AVG("Family Income") AS n FROM scholarship_applicants

plan.narrative: This dashboard provides a snapshot of scholarship applicants. The total number of applicants is {{p1}}. The majority of applicants are in the {{p2}} status.  Applicants are distributed across various talukas, with the highest concentration in {{p3}}. The average marks vary by category, with {{p4}} showing the highest average.  The monthly application trend, as indicated by {{p5}}, reveals fluctuations in application volume over time.  The top applicants by marks are listed in {{p6}}, and the average family income is {{p7}}.
